name: dense53-real-conveyor-caps
falsifier: No claim of overall improvement if recall, false alarms, or identity coverage regresses; report tradeoffs with counts. No real-driven selection.
box_conversion: Round xyxy endpoints, then subtract to form positive in-bounds integer xywh, identically for both models.
comparison: From-scratch native dense cap model versus fixed train12, identical truth and scoring; model family and scores differ.
stopping: One frozen evaluation per completed checkpoint; failures retained, no threshold retries on test results.

inference.mask_threshold_definition: Dense foreground uses native probability>=0.5 and8-connected components with at least9predictedpixels. Component score is mean foreground probability. Original truth is unchanged.

limits: Training and selection synthetic only; all five real videos previously exposed and used only for repeat validation.
Real box and trajectory labels are assistant-authored drafts, not independently reviewed. Real pixel-mask accuracy is unavailable.
Masks target visible vial caps, not whole hidden vials. Capture labels require at least9visible pixels.
Fresh synthetic test320frames/four appearance seeds from the same twin geometry; this is not evidence of physical reliability.
Box scores use maximum-cardinality one-to-one IoU>=0.5. Mask scores report0.5/0.75/0.9 at fixed detector confidence0.25; no maskAP is claimed.
Tracking is scored separately; low switches do not cancel missed vials or fragmented identities. IDs are camera-local, quality and removal unassessed.
Synthetic development-only package. No reserved capture or real evaluation is authorized by passing this package alone; absolute IDs and mask/detector gates must pass first.
Dense model retains8-connected components with at least9predictedpixels; alloriginaltruth remains scored. Score is mean foreground probability and uncalibrated. No NMS on disjoint masks.
Dense family final real/reserved evaluation requires separate passing development gate; this package has no real artifacts.
real_detection_scope: 45 fixed frames; truth and predictions both inclusive center-filtered to existing conveyor lane; IoU0.5 maximum-cardinality matching; primary includes uncertain labels; sensitivity excludes whole frames containing any uncertainty.
real_tracking_scope: Full-video inference, no resets between windows. Draft trajectory point/ID scoring in existing ROI[140,32,200,455], IoU0.5, reference y100 tolerance15frames. No interpolation. Existing evaluator semantics unchanged.
dense_detection_scope: Same draft trajectory ROI[140,32,200,455] and gap exclusion as identity scorer, IoU0.5 matching before association. Report detection recall separately from identity coverage.
hypothesis: Run48 with the synthetic-derived confidence floor0.90 reaches real proxy precision0.81/recall0.74; its remaining misses are large bright caps resting inside the dark square holder at the inspection station (probability near zero), a size and context the renders never show. Run53 keeps the Run48 recipe and makes pasted caps scaled0.8..1.6x and, half the time, places them on a drawn dark square so 'large cap on dark holder' is a positive. No real input of any kind. Not proof of causation.
synthetic_role: 320 reserved TEST frames from four new appearance seeds after model freeze; no selection from outcomes. Same twin geometry limits independence. This test is not the previous stress/occlusion regression gate.
synthetic_exit_matching: Fixed birth ownership, paired truth ID, overlapping inclusive crossing intervals with at most one source-frame tolerance; missed and unmatched events cannot cancel.
target_scope: Clean authored identities G01_cap/G02_cap/G03_cap and every procedural stress identity. No membership based on predictions or instantaneous motion. Preserve all images and original split.
development_gate_relaxation: Synthetic comparison and stable-ID gates recorded in the receipt, not required: the candidate is trained for real transfer.

dense_component_confidence_floor.rule: 1st percentile of true-cap component confidence on synthetic VAL (1280 frames), rounded down to 0.05; fixed before any real scoring

real_role: Previously exposed repeat validation of all five real cap_seal videos with assistant-authored draft labels; no training, selection or tuning on real data. Augmentation-trained candidate with a component confidence floor from synthetic VAL.
